capabilities: Preview interactive code blocks in reading mode
Run all code blocks in the preview
Author markdown using the Quartz interactive code block syntax
disambiguation: Not the actual interactive code block renderer; it is a limited authoring preview for blocks meant to run in a separate Quartz plugin.
extras: README is written in Dutch. The preview is explicitly not identical to the Quartz-rendered result: no editing, no sandbox mode, no syntax highlighting, and all code blocks become runnable.
motivation: The authors (Windesheim) use it to create and test markdown files with interactive code blocks during the writing process.
problem: Interactive code blocks written for Quartz cannot be previewed or tested inside Obsidian while writing the markdown.

relations.evidence: deze plugin is geen vervanging voor de daadwerkelijke interactive code block

summary: Authoring helper that previews Quartz-style interactive code blocks in reading mode while writing markdown.
